text:
Use with caution / monitor.

Proton pump inhibitors like omeprazole can cause hypochlorhydria and affect intragastric pH [levothyroxine:drug_interactions:15]. Because gastric acidity is required for adequate absorption of levothyroxine, this interaction can reduce its absorption [levothyroxine:drug_interactions:15]. Patients should be monitored appropriately or administered the drugs at least 4 hours apart [levothyroxine:drug_interactions:15, levothyroxine:drug_interactions:2].
